objective: Improve locally fine-tuned ViT over its exact pretrained initialization; disclose gains and regressions.
gradient_data: CASIA training identities in artifacts/transformer_training/split.json only
model_selection: CASIA validation identities only; compare clean AUC and fixed deterministic low-resolution/JPEG diagnostic AUC; no LFW DevTest or standard-fold selection.
candidate_families: quality-filtered within-class covariance residual projection: strengths [0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0], shrinkage [0.05,0.2,0.5]
quality-weighted robustness consistency + CosFace, last 4 blocks, 8 epochs, augmentation probability 0.5, anchor weight 2.0
compose fitted within-class projection with robust-trained ViT, same validation grid and family selection rule
final_evaluation: Once selected, compare exact initialization, round1, and selected refinement on original clean DevTest and official 10 folds; additionally report a separately labelled deterministic low-resolution/JPEG diagnostic on the same pairs.
limits: LFW test results have been observed in previous rounds; describe as public benchmark re-evaluation, not pristine untouched holdout. No inference-time access to test labels or identity-specific rules.
family_selection: Across candidate families, select maximum mean clean/diagnostic CASIA validation AUC, subject to clean AUC >= pretrained -.001. Final LFW evaluation follows selection.
audit: Additional 256 CASIA identities, seed 314, excluding all existing train/validation identities, will be used only for final comparison; no selection based on the audit.
